name: KENT Sapphire – White
summary: KENT Sapphire uses multiple purification process of RO+UF+Inline UV+Alkaline+ Copper+TDS Control to remove all dissolved impurities, bacteria and viruses while retaining essential natural minerals in water with KENT’s mineral RO™ technology.
intro: KENT Sapphire features an advanced RO + UF + Inline UV + Alkaline + Copper + TDS Control purification system that delivers 100% pure and healthy drinking water. It effectively removes bacteria, viruses, chemicals, and dissolved impurities such as arsenic, rust, pesticides, and fluorides while meeting IS:10500 drinking water standards. With a purification capacity of up to 20 litres per hour and an 8 litre storage tank, it ensures a continuous supply of purified water even during power outages. The advanced TDS Control system retains essential natural minerals while maintaining the desired TDS level for safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water. The Inline UV Technology and UV LED Light continuously disinfect the water and storage tank, preventing bacterial growth and ensuring long-lasting purity. This purifier also delivers mineral-rich alkaline water with a pH level of up to 9.5, helping regulate the body's pH balance, reduce acidity, support immunity, and promote overall wellness. It is further enriched with the goodness of Active Copper for additional health benefits. Backed by a 1 Year Warranty and 3 Years Free Service, KENT Sapphire is trusted by more than 1 crore satisfied consumers across India. It has received numerous national and international awards and is certified by both BIS and NSF, ensuring world-class quality, safety, and performance.
